items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So anyway, what I’m saying about Booker is that he was my best friend... We were very tight... we would have steps and stuff. We’d play a lot of gigs together

ctx.x: Before we leave Memphis, there’s a couple of things.
Yeah, before we leave Memphis. Don’t let me forget Booker Little.
That’s what I wanna... that’s one. That’s the one ­
